    Cohort-based Course

    AI Coding for Real Engineers

    A two-week cohort for developers who want to use AI coding tools on real production-style work: context gathering, planning, steering, feedback loops, AFK agents, and human-in-the-loop review.

    Matt Pocock

    A well-regarded expert developer known for his ability to demystify complex concepts.

    You're enrolled!

    Start with Before We Start to get your environment ready for the cohort.

    Do these three things first

    1. Clone the cohort repo and make sure it runs locally.
    2. Configure Claude Code and choose the model/setup you want to use for the course.
    3. Learn the exercise workflow: reset, cherry-pick, and pull.

    Then continue here

    • Work through Getting To Know Claude Code
    • Join Discord using the button above
    • Check the office hours schedule in the cohort contents below

    If you're blocked on setup, don't skip Before We Start. It's the fastest way to get unstuck.
